name: how-turkey-survived-ww2
title: How Turkey Survived WW2 Without Firing a Shot

voice.name: Charon
voice.style: Read briskly and punchily, like an energetic YouTube Shorts history narrator

scenes.say: For six years, Turkey sat between Hitler, Stalin and the British Empire.
And it never fired a single shot. How?
Turkey remembered the last war. Picking the losing side in World War One had cost the Ottomans their entire empire.
So President İsmet İnönü played everyone.
scenes.tts: So President Ismet Inönü played everyone.

scenes.say: In 1939, he signed a defense pact with Britain and France.
scenes.tts: In nineteen thirty-nine, he signed a defense pact with Britain and France.

scenes.say: In 1941, he signed a friendship treaty with Germany.
scenes.tts: In nineteen forty-one, he signed a friendship treaty with Germany.

scenes.say: And he sold chrome, a key metal for armour steel, to both sides.
In 1943, Churchill flew to Turkey himself to drag İnönü into the war.
scenes.tts: In nineteen forty-three, Churchill flew to Turkey himself to drag Inönü into the war.

scenes.say: Join us, and we'll send you planes and tanks!

voice.name: Algenib
voice.style: Say in the gruff, booming voice of an elderly British statesman

voice.name: Iapetus
voice.style: Say in a calm, polite, quietly amused diplomat's voice

scenes.say: Some weapons came. Turkey still stayed home.
Then, in February 1945, with Germany already collapsing, Turkey finally declared war.
scenes.tts: Then, in February nineteen forty-five, with Germany already collapsing, Turkey finally declared war.

scenes.say: Why then? Only countries at war with the Axis were invited to found the United Nations.
Turkey joined the winning side, with ten weeks to spare.
